metadata.evidence: we propose a new task, panoramic audiovisual salient object detection (PAV-SOD), which aims to segment the objects grasping most of the human attention in 360° panoramic videos reflecting real-life daily scenes.
metadata.reason: Names the core scientific task addressed by the artifact.

metadata.evidence: we collect PAVS10K, the first panoramic video dataset for audiovisual salient object detection
metadata.reason: Identifies the dataset introduced by this artifact.

metadata.value: consists of 67 4K-resolution equirectangular videos with per-video labels including hierarchical scene categories and associated attributes depicting specific challenges for conducting PAV-SOD, and 10,465 uniformly sampled video frames with manually annotated object-level and instance-level pixel-wise masks

metadata.value: 13 state-of-the-art salient object detection (SOD)/video object segmentation (VOS) methods
metadata.evidence: We further systematically benchmark 13 state-of-the-art salient object detection (SOD)/video object segmentation (VOS) methods based on our PAVS10K.
metadata.reason: Specifies the number and type of benchmarked baseline methods, useful for reproducibility and evaluation context.

metadata.evidence: Our CVAE-based audiovisual network, namely CAV-Net, consists of a spatial-temporal visual segmentation network, a convolutional audio-encoding network and audiovisual distribution estimation modules.
metadata.reason: Names the proposed baseline network/method introduced in the work.

metadata.value: a new baseline network, which takes advantage of both visual and audio cues of 360° video frames by using a new conditional variational auto-encoder (CVAE)
metadata.normalized_value: a new baseline network, which takes advantage of both visual and audio cues of 360° video frames by using a new conditional variational auto-encoder (CVAE)
metadata.evidence: Besides, we propose a new baseline network, which takes advantage of both visual and audio cues of 360° video frames by using a new conditional variational auto-encoder (CVAE).
metadata.reason: Describes the method/architecture underlying CAV-Net.
